title: Matcha Green Tea Mochi
description: A traditional Japanese dessert made with green tea-flavored mochi and white chocolate. Soft and chewy on the inside, crispy on the outside.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine white mochi and green tea matcha powder.
2. Gradually add in white chocolate chips and stir until well combined.
3. If desired, add in stir-fry sauce and mix until a dough forms.
4. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
5. Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and shape into balls.
6. Heat fry oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
7. Fry mochi balls until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
8. Remove mochi from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
